context.name: shopflow
context.domain_description: An online retail store where customers can browse products, add them to a cart, and place orders. Admins manage the product catalog and monitor all orders through a dashboard.

actors.permissions_description: Can browse products, add items to cart, place orders, and view their own order history.
Can manage the product catalog (create, update, remove products), view all customer orders, and update order states.

business_rules.description: Product stock must be sufficient before an order can be confirmed.
business_rules.trigger_condition: When Order transitions from Pending to Confirmed
business_rules.enforcement_action: Reject with 422 if any OrderItem.quantity exceeds Product.stock

business_rules.description: Order total must equal the sum of all OrderItem unit_price × quantity values.
business_rules.trigger_condition: When an Order is created or an OrderItem is added
business_rules.enforcement_action: Recalculate and update Order.total automatically; reject if mismatch on read

business_rules.description: An order can only be cancelled while in Pending state.
business_rules.enforcement_action: Reject with 409 if Order.state is not Pending

use_cases.name: Browse Products
use_cases.description: Customer views the product catalog with filtering and sorting options.

use_cases.name: Place Order
use_cases.description: Customer submits a cart as a new order; stock is verified and total is calculated.

use_cases.name: View Order History
use_cases.description: Customer views their past and current orders with status updates.

use_cases.name: Manage Product Catalog
use_cases.description: Admin creates, updates, and removes products including stock levels.

use_cases.name: View All Orders
use_cases.description: Admin views all customer orders and can update their state.
